approved_drugs.py.why: A panel of 77 approved oral drugs with an in-window/out-of-window split. Every threshold in MolCascade's shipped defaults was calibrated against it, so it is the reference ETALON measures its own gates on. It lives in the excluded test tree upstream, which is where a test fixture belongs and not where reference data is findable.
